meta.subject: PDP udpate: surface counter bit width from fixed value to configurable bit width PDP/CDP udpate: change pos_c bit width from 3bit to 5bits becasue max atmm/tp=32

en.summary: The commit fixes PDP/CDP metadata and counter width truncation by widening `pos_c` and related packet and counter fields so larger atomic-size-to-throughput ratios are handled correctly.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes insufficient bit widths and the required fix.
It changes central PDP and CDP RTL datapath and control files, not only tests or docs.
The patch widens counters, packet fields, and end-condition logic that directly affect DUT behavior.
disqualifiers: The patch is broad and includes generated RAM collateral.
Fault injection needs to target the RTL logic rather than the generated memory models.
evidence: `NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_bufferin_tp1.v` changes `buffer_pos_c`, `dp_pos_c`, and packed metadata from 3 bits to 5 bits and expands the packet width from `+15` to `+17`.
`NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_eg.v` changes `dp_pos_c` to 5 bits and repacks `pdp_rdma2dp_pd` with wider metadata fields.
`NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_ig.v` makes `number_of_block_in_c` and `count_c` depend on `NVDLA_MEMORY_ATOMIC_SIZE` instead of fixed widths.
The commit message states that 3 bits are insufficient because `max atmm/tp=32`.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A streaming image-processing pipeline carries channel-position metadata and per-surface counters alongside data beats. When those fields are sized for a smaller atomic-size to throughput ratio than the configured design actually uses, channel position and end-of-surface bookkeeping overflow or truncate. The result is corrupted packet metadata and wrong end-of-channel or end-of-surface decisions in PDP and CDP processing.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: channel-position metadata and channel or surface end counters
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Configurations with many channel blocks per transaction, especially when atomic-size divided by datapath throughput exceeds the old fixed-width assumption.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore stale fixed widths for channel-position metadata and related counters so high channel indices wrap or compare incorrectly.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: truncate metadata field and revert configurable counter widths to fixed narrow widths
portability_notes: Map this to the metadata that accompanies each data beat, not only to a top-level configuration register.
If the design has separate producer and consumer pipelines, inject the bug consistently wherever pos_c or equivalent fields are packed and unpacked.
The failure often appears only on larger channel counts or wider memory atomic settings.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the beat metadata field that carries channel position or sub-channel index through the pipeline.
Reduce that field to the stale narrow width used by an older configuration assumption.
Restore fixed-width channel or surface counters and old compare logic for detecting the last channel block.
Keep data payload width and handshakes otherwise unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: PDP and CDP pos_c metadata packing, unpacking, and last-channel counters
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens pos_c from 3 to 5 bits across PDP and CDP packet formats, widens transfer and counter state in RDMA logic, and updates end-of-channel comparisons.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore 3-bit pos_c fields and the old fixed-width counter logic in NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_bufferin_tp1.v, NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_cvtin.v, NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_eg.v, NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_ig.v, and NV_NVDLA_PDP_CORE_preproc.v.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Large-channel workloads can mis-tag channel position, assert last-channel or last-surface at the wrong time, or drop or repeat slices because metadata wraps.
evidence_for_injection: The patch widens both packed metadata fields and the counters that interpret them.
The commit message names the specific configuration pressure: max atmm/tp=32.
The fix updates both producer and consumer sides of the metadata path, which is consistent with a real truncation bug.
notes: Generated RAM model files in the commit are collateral and do not need to be mutated.
A partial reinjection that truncates only the metadata field or only the end-counter logic can still expose the same bug class.

zh.summary: 该提交通过扩大 `pos_c` 及相关包字段和计数器位宽，修复了 PDP 和 CDP 元数据与计数器被截断的问题，从而正确支持更大的 atomic-size 与 throughput 比值。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明了位宽不足以及修复原因。
它修改的是 PDP 和 CDP 的核心 RTL 数据通路和控制文件，而不是仅修改测试或文档。
补丁直接扩大了计数器、打包字段和结束条件逻辑，这些都会影响 DUT 行为。
disqualifiers: 补丁范围较大，并包含了生成的 RAM 相关文件。
做故障注入时应针对 RTL 逻辑本身，而不是生成出来的存储模型。
evidence: `NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_bufferin_tp1.v` 把 `buffer_pos_c`、`dp_pos_c` 以及打包元数据从 3 位扩到 5 位，并把包宽从 `+15` 扩到 `+17`。
`NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_eg.v` 把 `dp_pos_c` 扩成 5 位，并重新打包更宽的 `pdp_rdma2dp_pd` 元数据字段。
`NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_ig.v` 让 `number_of_block_in_c` 和 `count_c` 依赖 `NVDLA_MEMORY_ATOMIC_SIZE`，而不是使用固定宽度。
提交信息明确写到 3 位不够，因为 `max atmm/tp=32`。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在流式图像处理流水线中，通道位置元数据和按 surface 计数的控制状态会与数据 beat 一起流动。如果这些字段仍按更小的 atomic-size/throughput 比值来定宽，而实际配置更大，那么通道位置和 surface 结束记账就会溢出或截断，进而导致 PDP/CDP 处理中出现包元数据损坏以及错误的 end-of-channel / end-of-surface 判定。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 通道位置元数据以及通道/表面结束计数器
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 每个事务包含很多通道块的配置，尤其是 atomic-size 除以 datapath throughput 超过旧固定宽度假设时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把通道位置元数据和相关计数器恢复为陈旧的固定窄位宽，使较大的通道索引发生回绕或比较错误。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 截断元数据字段，并把可配置计数器恢复成固定窄位宽
portability_notes: 应映射到随每个 data beat 一起流动的元数据，而不只是顶层配置寄存器。
如果设计有分离的生产者和消费者流水线，应在所有打包/解包 `pos_c` 或等价字段的地方一致注入。
这种故障通常只会在较大通道数或更宽 memory atomic 配置下出现。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在流水线中随数据 beat 传播的通道位置或子通道索引元数据字段。
把该字段位宽缩回到旧配置假设下的窄位宽。
同时恢复固定宽度的通道/表面计数器以及旧的 last-channel 判定逻辑。
保持数据负载宽度和握手逻辑不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: PDP/CDP 中 pos_c 元数据的打包、解包以及 last-channel 计数逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 补丁把 PDP/CDP 包格式中的 pos_c 从 3 位扩到 5 位，扩大了 RDMA 逻辑中的传输/计数状态，并更新了通道结束比较逻辑。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_bufferin_tp1.v、NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_cvtin.v、NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_eg.v、NV_NVDLA_PDP_RDMA_ig.v 和 NV_NVDLA_PDP_CORE_preproc.v 中恢复 3 位 pos_c 字段以及旧的固定宽度计数逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在大通道工作负载下，channel position 可能被错误标记，last-channel/last-surface 可能在错误时刻触发，从而导致切片丢失、重复或顺序错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁同时扩大了打包元数据字段和解释这些字段的计数器。
提交信息直接点出了配置压力来源：max atmm/tp=32。
修复同时覆盖元数据生产端和消费端，这符合真实截断类错误的特征。
notes: 提交中生成出来的 RAM model 文件只是 collateral，不需要参与故障注入。
即便只截断元数据字段或只回退 end-counter 逻辑，也能暴露同一类故障。
